data.long_meaning: The name Prescott originated from Old English, specifically from Prescot, meaning 'priest's village'. This name was popular among English settlers in America, and is now a common name in many English-speaking countries. The name Prescott carries the meaning “Priest's village” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Prescott usually hope their child will grow to embody priest's village and live with faith, good character and purpose.
